title: hive bot reload output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive bot reload --json`. Sends SIGHUP to a live bot process. Reports ok=true when the signal was delivered; ok=false when no bot is running.

ok.description: True only when SIGHUP was delivered.

pid.description: PID that was signalled, or null when no PID was available.

reason.description: Why reload was refused. Present only when ok=false.
